# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 15 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## GLS & Private Market

- **Hong Leong-TID JV wins Orchard Boulevard GLS site at S$1,755 psf ppr** - URA has awarded the Orchard Boulevard Government Land Sale site to Intrepid Investments and TID Residential for S$181.86 million, or approximately S$1,755 psf ppr. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

- **Lentor area now has 3,400 new homes; Lentor Modern early buyers averaged S$314K gain** - A review of all seven new Lentor condos covers land prices, sales volumes, sub-sale gains and rental performance since the area's development began. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/lentor-moderns-early-buyers-made-312k-on-average-how-all-7-new-lentor-condos-have-done-so-far-2/)

## HDB Resale & BTO

- **November 2026 BTO draws over 35,600 applications — two-room flats hit record applicant numbers** - The November BTO exercise recorded its highest application rate since 2022, with two-room flats attracting a record number of applicants across seven projects offering 7,964 flats. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/november-bto-draws-35600-applications-two/)

- **Yishun records first-ever S$1.3M HDB resale — executive flat sells for S$1,328,888** - An executive apartment at Block 652 Yishun Avenue 4 transacted at S$1,328,888 in November 2026, becoming Yishun's most expensive HDB resale across all flat types and the first in the town to cross the S$1.3 million mark. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/yishun-hdb-resale-record-nee-soon-central-view/)

- **February 2027 BTO launch previewed — about 4,300 flats across Bishan, Toa Payoh, Tampines and Tengah** - HDB's upcoming February 2027 exercise is reviewed site by site, covering expected prices and anticipated demand for each of the four locations. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/review-february-2027-bto-launch-sites/)
